en.hero.subtitle: Frontend developer from Dushanbe, Tajikistan. I create responsive websites with clean code — HTML, CSS, JavaScript & Supabase.
en.about.title: A bit about me
en.about.p1: I'm a Computer Science student and frontend developer based in Dushanbe, Tajikistan. I build web interfaces and tools using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Supabase as a backend.
en.about.p2: My recent project — Kamarob Nature Fund — is a multilingual conservation website (EN / RU / DE / TJ) with a live Supabase backend, dynamic slug-based routing, and a custom i18n system, deployed on GitHub Pages.
en.about.p3: I take on freelance projects through Fiverr and Upwork while continuing to grow as a developer. I write clean, readable code that's easy for any developer to pick up and continue.
